_comment: Kingmaker's extension directory (lib/extensions.mjs). Every entry is checked by hand against the maker's own page; a bundle carries its sha256. Keys are never here: each key names the page where it is made, and Kingmaker opens that page beside the bar.

extensions.name: Blender
extensions.summary: Natural language interface with the Python API and documentation
extensions.description: Blender MCP offers a natural language interface with Blender's Python API, improving access to documentation, and allowing users to explore and understand complex setups.

addon.name: Blender MCP add-on
addon.steps: In Blender: drag the add-on zip onto the window (or Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install from Disk), then turn it on.

extensions.warning: Blender's makers warn that this runs AI-written code in Blender without guards. Use it on files you can afford to lose, and keep backups.

extensions.name: Cloudflare
extensions.summary: Your Cloudflare account: Workers, DNS, R2, D1 and the rest of the API
extensions.description: Cloudflare's own MCP server reaches the whole Cloudflare API: deploy and inspect Workers, manage DNS, storage and databases, and read logs.

keys.label: Cloudflare API token
keys.help: Create Token → pick only the permissions this needs → copy it once, then paste it into Kingmaker's key box.

extensions.name: GitHub
extensions.summary: Repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions
extensions.description: GitHub's own MCP server: read code, open and review pull requests, manage issues and check Actions runs.

keys.label: GitHub personal access token
keys.help: A fine-grained token, limited to the repositories this should reach. Copy it once, then paste it into Kingmaker's key box.

extensions.name: Postiz
extensions.summary: Every social media account in one place: schedule and publish posts
extensions.description: Postiz connects X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and more. Through one key Kingmaker sees every account connected to that Postiz workspace and drafts and schedules posts for them; posting waits for your OK.

keys.label: Postiz API key
keys.help: In Postiz: Settings → Developers → Public API → copy the key. One key covers every social account in that workspace; add another key for another workspace.
